# Expeditious Retreat (`spells:expeditious-retreat`)
**Level 1 [Transmutation](../magic-schools/transmutation.md) (Concentration)** | **Casting Time:** Bonus Action | **Range:** Self
**Components:** V, S | **Duration:** up to 10 minutes | **Classes:** [Sorcerer](../classes/sorcerer.md), [Warlock](../classes/warlock.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

You take the Dash action, and until the spell ends, you can take that action again as a Bonus Action.
